description: Cross-binding conformance for §6.6.5 inline-test assertions on a STATE-DEPENDENT array OBSERVED. The asserted `g[i] = 2*u[i] + rate[i]` is an array-shaped observed of an integrated state: its field moves with the trajectory, so no build-time product can carry it (only STATE-FREE observeds hoist into a build inspection's setup arrays) and no scalar output row can either. A binding must therefore evaluate the observed's own defining expression at the SAMPLED STATE — the same 'a reference denotes its expansion' semantics (§5.23) that already made scalar observeds assertable — and then apply the ordinary `reduce` collapses and `coords` point-samples. Before the fix all three bindings refused such an assertion outright with 'array state <v> has no cells in var_map'. The fixture's `rate` is the STATE-FREE array observed of the same document, asserted alongside as the regression guard that the build-materialized path still answers. Julia is the reference binding: its `run_pde_tests` minted golden/observed_state_dependent.json. The fixture's right-hand side is a per-cell CONSTANT, so u(t) = i^2 + i*t is integrated exactly by every solver family named below and the goldens are integrator-independent to machine precision.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator / inline PDE-test runner
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator / inline PDE-test runner
